# DocsScale

> Marketing agency for healthcare clinics in the US. DocsScale runs the whole patient-acquisition journey for clinics and reports in booked appointments and patients who showed, never clicks.

DocsScale works only with healthcare clinics: dental, chiropractic, physical therapy, med spa, weight loss, dermatology, primary care, optometry, and mental health. The offer is one system with four stages: Attract, Capture, Convert, Retain. Engagements are month to month with 30 days' notice, and the clinic owns every ad account, page, phone number, and its data.

## Services
- Paid ads (Meta & Google), one service line at a time — reported in booked appointments
- Local SEO & Google Business Profile — rank for treatments in the neighborhoods served
- Social media management — planned a month ahead, in the clinic's voice
- Websites & landing pages — a clinic site and per-service landing pages built to book, fast on phones
- Lead follow-up & booking — every inquiry answered within minutes, missed-call text-back, reminders
- Reviews & reputation — review requests after every visit
- Reactivation & recall — past patients invited back, in the clinic's name, without discounts

## How it works
- Free 30-minute strategy call, then build (weeks 1–3), launch, and a weekly Monday report
- Typical first booked patients from ads within 2–3 weeks; full pipeline by month three
- The clinic approves all patient-facing content before launch
